# Tasks Document

- [ ] 1. Move pure math into geometry/ and SVG into formats/
  - Files: veccy/geometry/{__init__,affine,boxes,segments,booleans,transforms,nodes}.py, veccy/formats/{__init__,svg}.py, every importer in veccy/, tests/, scripts/; delete veccy/controllers/{geometry,affine,nodes,svg_io}.py
  - Split controllers/geometry.py by topic (boxes: Point, Rect, box_from_drag, new rect_from_points; segments; booleans; transforms); one Rect definition replaces overlay/handles copies; reuse rect_from_points in SelectGesture/NodeGesture/CanvasGestures band code
  - Purpose: pure code lives below render; dependency direction becomes true
  - _Leverage: existing modules moved verbatim; tests/test_geometry.py, test_affine.py, test_nodes.py, test_svg_io.py_
  - _Requirements: 1.1, 1.2, 1.4, 6.1, 6.4_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec editor-architecture, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Python developer doing a mechanical package move | Task: Create geometry/ and formats/ per design.md (Package layout) and move code without behavior change; update all imports; keep AppController importing from the new places | Restrictions: No logic changes beyond the Rect/rect_from_points dedupe; speaking names; no Qt in new packages; don't touch views behavior | Success: full pytest green, app runs (screenshot_app.py), no module imports veccy.controllers.{geometry,affine,nodes,svg_io}. Before starting set this task to [-] in tasks.md; after finishing log it with log-implementation (with artifacts) and set it to [x]._

- [ ] 2. Architecture test (current rules)
  - Files: tests/test_architecture.py
  - ast-scan every veccy module: Qt-free packages (models, geometry, formats, render, controllers for now) and allowed import directions that already hold after task 1
  - Purpose: lock in each step's layering
  - _Requirements: 1.2, 1.3, 1.5_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec editor-architecture, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Python developer writing static checks | Task: Write tests/test_architecture.py per design.md (Architecture table, Error scenario 4) with a rules table that later tasks tighten; failures name module and import | Restrictions: stdlib ast only; no importing app modules | Success: test passes now and fails when a forbidden import is added (verify manually once). Before starting set this task to [-] in tasks.md; after finishing log it with log-implementation (with artifacts) and set it to [x]._

- [ ] 3. Session with labelled undo history
  - Files: veccy/editing/{__init__,session}.py, veccy/controllers/app_controller.py, tests/editing/test_session.py, pyproject.toml (pytest --import-mode=importlib), tests/conftest.py
  - Session: state, subscribe/notify, edit(label, merge_key) context manager, undo/redo with labels, reset, end_merge, after-restore hook; AppController delegates history/notify to it, labels added at each checkpoint
  - Purpose: one place for history and notification
  - _Leverage: AppController._checkpoint/_restore/undo/redo/_snapshot/_copy_document_
  - _Requirements: 2.1, 2.2, 2.3, 2.4, 2.6_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec editor-architecture, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Python developer | Task: Implement Session per design.md (editing/session.py) and make AppController use it internally without API change; tests: labelled step, merge key, exception leaves history/state untouched and no notify, labels for undo/redo, undo prunes selection and clears node selection | Restrictions: Status messages unchanged; undo limit 200; no Qt | Success: new and existing tests green. Before starting set this task to [-] in tasks.md; after finishing log it with log-implementation (with artifacts) and set it to [x]._

- [ ] 4. Queries and operation registry
  - Files: veccy/editing/{queries,registry}.py, veccy/editing/operations/__init__.py, tests/editing/test_registry.py
  - queries: visible_shapes, selected_shapes, find_shape, active_layer, can_combine, can_object_to_path, plus write helpers replace_shape, remove_shapes, map_selected, new_id (or operations/_document.py); registry: Operation, @operation, register, operations, find
  - Purpose: shared reads/helpers and the command table
  - _Requirements: 3.4, 3.5, 3.6_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec editor-architecture, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Python developer | Task: Implement queries.py and registry.py per design.md; tests for registry order, duplicate id ValueError, invoke respects can_run | Restrictions: Registry holds definitions only, no app state; no Qt | Success: tests green. Before starting set this task to [-] in tasks.md; after finishing log it with log-implementation (with artifacts) and set it to [x]._

- [ ] 5. Port operations: view, selection, shapes, style, history
  - Files: veccy/editing/operations/{view,selection,shapes,style,history}.py, veccy/controllers/app_controller.py (forwarders), tests/editing/test_{view,selection,shapes,style}.py (moved from tests/test_app_controller.py)
  - Purpose: first half of AppController as plain functions
  - _Leverage: AppController method bodies_
  - _Requirements: 2.2, 3.1, 3.2, 3.3, 3.7_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec editor-architecture, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Python developer | Task: Move the listed controller methods into operation modules per design.md (Operations, by example), with `with session.edit(label)` and unchanged status messages; register edit.undo/redo/select_all/delete, view.zoom_in/zoom_out/zoom_actual; AppController methods forward to them; move matching tests with same assertions | Restrictions: Speaking names, no behavior change, each module well under 400 lines | Success: full suite green. Before starting set this task to [-] in tasks.md; after finishing log it with log-implementation (with artifacts) and set it to [x]._

- [ ] 6. Port operations: transform, paths, node_editing, layers, documents
  - Files: veccy/editing/operations/{transform,paths,node_editing,layers,documents}.py, veccy/controllers/app_controller.py (forwarders), tests/editing/test_{transform,paths,node_editing,layers,documents}.py
  - Purpose: second half of AppController
  - _Leverage: AppController method bodies, render/export.py, formats/svg.py_
  - _Requirements: 2.2, 3.1, 3.2, 3.3, 3.7_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec editor-architecture, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Python developer | Task: Same as task 5 for the remaining methods; register path.union/difference/object_to_path, layer.add/remove; documents use Session.reset; I/O errors still caught around file access only | Restrictions: No behavior change, SVG output identical | Success: full suite green; AppController contains only forwarders. Before starting set this task to [-] in tasks.md; after finishing log it with log-implementation (with artifacts) and set it to [x]._

- [ ] 7. Switch callers to session + operations; delete controllers/
  - Files: veccy/app.py, veccy/views/*.py, scripts/*.py, tests/**; delete veccy/controllers/
  - Purpose: views and gestures call operations/queries directly
  - _Requirements: 1.4, 2.1, 3.1, 6.2_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec editor-architecture, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: PySide6 developer | Task: Replace AppController usage everywhere with Session + operation/query calls; App creates the Session; delete AppController and controllers/; update architecture test rules | Restrictions: Views never assign AppState; keep `lambda: slot()` for triggered; no behavior change | Success: full suite green, screenshot and a QTest scratch run (select/move/scale/node/layers/save) behave as before, offscreen and desktop GL. Before starting set this task to [-] in tasks.md; after finishing log it with log-implementation (with artifacts) and set it to [x]._

- [ ] 8. Keymap and actions built from the registries; undo/redo labels
  - Files: veccy/views/{keymap,actions,menu_bar_view,toolbar_view,left_sidebar_view,main_window}.py, tests/views/test_keymap.py
  - Binding(shortcut, icon), MENUS/MAIN_TOOLBAR/TOOL_STRIP layouts; actions from operations + tool list + window commands; enabled via can_run; Undo/Redo text with label
  - Purpose: no hand-wired QActions; one keymap
  - _Requirements: 2.5, 5.1, 5.2, 5.3, 5.4_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec editor-architecture, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: PySide6 developer | Task: Implement keymap.py and rebuild actions/menus/toolbars per design.md (views/keymap.py, views/actions.py); test that every layout id resolves to an operation, tool or window command (Qt-free import of keymap data) | Restrictions: Menus, order, labels, shortcuts, icons, tooltips identical to before except Undo/Redo labels; tool ids may reference the old tool tuple until task 9 | Success: screenshot shows identical menus/toolbars; QTest check of shortcuts (Delete, Ctrl+Z label, N, Ctrl+Shift+C). Before starting set this task to [-] in tasks.md; after finishing log it with log-implementation (with artifacts) and set it to [x]._

- [ ] 9. tools/ package with BaseTool and tool registry
  - Files: veccy/tools/{__init__,base,registry,select,node,pen,shapes,text}.py, veccy/views/canvas_view.py, veccy/views/keymap.py, tests/tools/test_{select,node,drawing}.py; delete veccy/views/{canvas_gestures,select_gesture,node_gesture,gesture_types}.py
  - Purpose: tools as their own layer; CanvasView dispatches
  - _Leverage: current gesture modules and tests_
  - _Requirements: 4.1, 4.2, 4.3, 4.4, 4.5_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec editor-architecture, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Python developer | Task: Move gesture code into tools/ per design.md (tools/base.py, tools/registry.py, views/canvas_view.py) incl. ToolContext.shape_at and BaseTool.key for the pen's Enter; split gesture tests per tool with same assertions | Restrictions: Tools call operations only; no Qt in tools; CanvasView checks no tool types; behavior identical | Success: full suite green; QTest scratch run of all tools offscreen and desktop GL; bench within noise. Before starting set this task to [-] in tasks.md; after finishing log it with log-implementation (with artifacts) and set it to [x]._

- [ ] 10. Final rules, verification and docs
  - Files: tests/test_architecture.py, CLAUDE.md, README.md (Development section if needed), .spec-workflow/steering/{tech,structure,product}.md, scripts/{bench_canvas,screenshot_app}.py
  - Tighten architecture test to the final table; SVG before/after comparison; bench and screenshot; rewrite architecture docs (session/operations/tools/views, layout, dependency rule, no MVC wording); check no app module over ~400 lines
  - Purpose: verified restructuring and truthful docs
  - _Requirements: 1.5, 6.1, 6.2, 6.3, 6.4, 7.1, 7.2, 7.3_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec editor-architecture, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Python developer focused on quality and docs | Task: Finish per design.md Migration Plan step 7 and Testing Strategy; compare SVG output of a scripted document between the pre-spec commit and now | Restrictions: Hedged public wording in README/FAQ; delete scratch scripts after use; don't start long-running servers | Success: suite green, SVG identical, bench within noise, docs updated, line counts reported. Before starting set this task to [-] in tasks.md; after finishing log it with log-implementation (with artifacts) and set it to [x]._
